outcome: Identification of variations in clinical practices related to neonatal encephalopathy management
cohort: 502 newborns with neonatal encephalopathy (NE) evaluated for Therapeutic Hypothermia from 14 centers in Massachusetts.
finding: The established regional registry allowed for the identification of areas of variation in clinical practices for neonatal encephalopathy management, including TH eligibility screening and post-natal care, which are guiding ongoing quality improvement projects.
